author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: पुनर्भजनप्रकारमेवाह ॥ मच्चिता इति । मन्निष्ठमनस्काः । मद्गतप्राणाः मद्विषयचेष्टावन्तः। बोधयन्तः शिष्यान्प्रति बोधयन्तो मामुपदेशेनेति योज्यम् । परस्परं मां कथयन्तः कीर्तयन्तश्च नित्यमिति सर्वत्रान्वेति । तुष्यन्ति तृप्ता भवन्ति । विषयेष्वलम्बुद्धिमन्तो भवन्ति । तत्र हेतुः रमन्ति च सुखमनुभवन्ति चेति ॥ १०.९॥
translation:
With their mind fixed on Me, with their activity directed to Me, imparting (My knowledge to pupils), mutually talking about Me, they are ever contented and delighted.  (9)
V. Prana: energy, activity. They use all their energy in intensifying their devotion to Me and in working their way to Me. Nitya (ever) is to be construed as qualifying every epithet. Contended: turned away from the objects of sense, for which they have begun to feel a disgust. (9.)
A. In the next two the fruit of the worship is declared.
